title: GoodDollar UBI claims on XDC
tagline: Every UBIScheme event on XDC since the contract was deployed, indexed from a public RPC by one Rust binary. No HyperSync, no hosted indexer.

queries.title: Latest claims
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, block_timestamp, claimer, amount_dec FROM ubi_scheme__u_b_i_claimed ORDER BY block_number DESC, log_index DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Claims per day, last 14 days of data
queries.sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(block_timestamp)) AS day, count(*) AS claims, sum(amount_dec) AS total_base_units FROM ubi_scheme__u_b_i_claimed WHERE block_timestamp > (SELECT max(block_timestamp) FROM ubi_scheme__u_b_i_claimed) - 14 * 86400 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

queries.title: Distinct claimers, ever
queries.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT claimer) AS claimers, count(*) AS claims FROM ubi_scheme__u_b_i_claimed

queries.title: Top 10 claimers by number of claims
queries.sql: SELECT claimer, count(*) AS claims, min(block_timestamp) AS first_claim, max(block_timestamp) AS last_claim FROM ubi_scheme__u_b_i_claimed GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY claims DESC LIMIT 10

queries.title: Daily UBI per claimer, latest protocol days
queries.sql: SELECT "day", "dailyUbi_dec", "blockNumber" FROM ubi_scheme__u_b_i_calculated ORDER BY block_number DESC LIMIT 20

prompts: Count UBIClaimed events per UTC day for the last 14 days of data on this nest and give the total G$ claimed per day. Amounts are in the amount_dec column with 18 decimals.
How many distinct addresses have ever claimed UBI on XDC, and how many claimed in the most recent 30 days of data?
List the top 10 claimers by number of claims with their first and last claim time.
Join UBICalculated (day, dailyUbi_dec) with the claim count per day. Which protocol days changed the daily UBI per claimer by more than 20 percent from the previous day?
What is the highest block this nest has indexed and what is the timestamp of the newest claim? Then list every table with its row count.
